newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rostelekom chief - Svyazinvest transfer no problem.
newsitem.headline: Rostelekom chief - Svyazinvest transfer no problem.

text.p: The transfer of the Russian government's stake in long-distance telephone operator Rostelekom to telecom holding company Svyazinvest would not hurt Rostelekom, its chief executive said on Friday.
"The transfer of the state's controlling shares in Rostelekom to Svyazinvest will not change anything for Rostelekom," Oleg Belov said in a statement.
Government officials have said that the state will give Svyazinvest its 38 percent stake in Rostelekom, which includes the majority of voting shares.
The government also plans to sell 49 percent of Svyazinvest to foreign and Russian portfolio investors this year.
"Rostelekom's shares will make Svyazinvest shares more attractive," Belov said.

Rostelekom plans to attract $500 million dollars of investment between 1997 and 1999 to modernise its network, Belov said. Rostelekom's total development programme for the period between 1992 and 2005 will be worth $3.5-$4 billion, he said.
